question: Does the unchanged nearest-member object-context memory rank all three new C16 query views above its pre-descriptor same-scene sibling and both fixed cross-family controls?

predecessor.single_change: Apply the unchanged consumed-PV28 nearest-member object-context descriptor to the fully new pre-download-frozen C16 family with frozen same-scene and cross-family negatives.

descriptor.feature: Unchanged exact-bbox plus 1.5x-context DINOv2 CLS descriptor.
descriptor.score: Maximum cosine to any frozen reference member.

evaluation.decision_gate: All nine positive-versus-negative nearest-member comparisons must be strictly ordered correctly; no threshold or margin is fitted.
evaluation.negative_authority: SIB32 is a different instance in the same new rescan selected before RGB/model access; NC31/NC08 are exact-target-absent cross-family controls.

literature_motivation.use: Confirm viewpoint-preserving object memory on an entirely new family with a same-scene sibling challenge.

forbidden_after_freeze: change descriptor, crop, memory member, negative or gate
use query truth to select a memory member
claim_boundary: This new-family test can establish only narrow same-provider confirmation of nearest-member object-context memory under privileged boxes. It cannot establish calibrated open-set decisions, broad sibling rejection, raw-camera binding, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, deployment, benefit, reliability or safety.
